evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents translate model outputs into consequential actions, turning indirect prompt injection into an execution-security problem.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: An offline LLM proposes instance-independent action--state axioms, which are accepted only if they address ontology errors exposed by training failures, preserve logical consistency and protected entailments, and pass held-out validation before the ontology is frozen.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate \ours{} on AgentDojo, ASB, and AgentDyn under benign and indirect prompt-injection settings. \ours{} achieves a 0\% attack success rate (ASR) across all three benchmarks while improving task utility under attack compared with existing baselines.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Existing defenses constrain tool calls, trajectories, or information flows, but often leave action semantics, state dependencies, and evidence relations implicit, limiting generalization across heterogeneous tools and complicating safe updates.
